name: Zapier
tagline: Zapier is the most widely used no-code automation platform, connecting 6,000+ apps through simple 'if this, then that' workflows called Zaps. Its AI features include natural-language workflow creation (describe what you want to automate and Zapier builds the Zap) and AI actions that connect LLMs like ChatGPT directly into your automations. Over 2 million businesses use Zapier to eliminate manual handoffs between their software tools.
